$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — LLM commander (L-1 CE-4676, L-2 CE-4679 ⑤, L-2b CE-4680; docs/designs/llm-commander/DESIGN_LLM_Commander.md §1, §5b): the Platoon's brain is a seat with the SCRIPTED mind, which runs the platoon's own PlatoonAttack play on the first SPOT (run_play, CE-4680 B-1); Alpha Squad and Bravo Squad fight with the game AI; Red's Defenders hold the sheds. Blue starts behind the L-Block, the objective and the support position are behind the Low Wall, six 1.5 m walls stagger the lane to the house; the platoon carries a CommanderBrief and its places PlaceNotes (B-2, B-6). Measured 2026-11-22 (two runs): PlatoonAttack at 78 s, Bravo supports and reports TargetsDown at ~3:00, Alpha closes by fire and movement; every Red man down by the end, one Bravo man lost. ⚠ The L-2 row 'Red still fires 60 s after its first shot' is gone: with the play Red is beaten after about a minute of fire; the fight's length is judged from Blue's side, and L-1's check ④ is back as its 'Red is beaten' branch (DECISIONS_Backend CE-4680 #1). FEATURE scenario (no golden until two fresh runs agree, §5). The 'report' cue reads the brain node's report log (editor tier). · ⭐ CE-4681 (L-3 ④, DESIGN_LLM_Commander §5a-3): the two rows only the SCRIPTED mind can pass ('both squads to the objective at the start', 'the platoon's own play never runs' — a model plans otherwise and may run PlatoonBound itself) carry "if": "scriptedMind" — a model run SKIPS them.

expect.name: both squads are sent to the objective at the start
the platoon runs its PlatoonAttack play within 1 s of the first SPOT into the platoon (run_play, CE-4680)
the platoon's own play never runs (no PlatoonHold, no ReactToFireFromBuilding)
Alpha Squad reports to the platoon
Bravo Squad reports to the platoon
the fight lasts at least a minute: Blue still fires 60 s after Red's first shot (CE-4679 ⑤)
the fight ends before the time limit with Red beaten: every Red man down (L-1 check ④, its 'Red is beaten' branch)
